pages.title: Easy Capybara Standing in Profile Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a capybara standing in profile, with a broad muzzle, short sturdy legs, and small tufts of grass beneath its feet.

pages.title: Cute Capybara Sitting with Tucked Paws Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara sits with its front paws tucked together and its chin lifted in this printable coloring page, above two rounded stones on the ground.

pages.title: Capybara Face with Small Round Ears Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page centers on a capybara face with small round ears, a broad muzzle, and a shaggy outline around both cheeks.

pages.title: Baby Capybara Napping in the Grass Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby capybara naps with its chin between its front paws in this printable coloring page, surrounded by grass tufts and a few scattered leaves.

pages.title: Kawaii Capybara Hugging a Heart Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a kawaii capybara wraps both paws around a large heart while three smaller hearts float around its head.

pages.title: Capybara in a Hot Spring with Yuzu Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara soaks in a steaming hot spring in this printable coloring page, with three floating yuzu fruits, smooth rocks, and a fence behind the pool.

pages.title: Capybara with a Duckling on Its Back Coloring Page
pages.description: A duckling with an open bill perches on a capybara’s back in this printable coloring page, its webbed feet visible above the capybara’s shaggy fur.

pages.title: Capybara Eating a Slice of Watermelon Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara bites into a slice of watermelon in this printable coloring page, holding the curved rind in both paws with teardrop seeds beneath its muzzle.

pages.title: Capybara Holding a Giant Strawberry Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated capybara cradles a giant strawberry in this printable coloring page, with a curved stem, a leafy cap, and outlined seeds on the fruit.

pages.title: Kawaii Capybara Drinking Boba Tea Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a kawaii capybara sipping boba tea, with a wide straw, star designs on the cup, and six round tapioca pearls.

pages.title: Cartoon Capybara Waving with One Paw Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling cartoon capybara raises one paw to wave in this printable coloring page, with both back feet resting on a single straight ground line.

pages.title: Realistic Capybara Grazing By a River Coloring Page
pages.description: A realistic capybara lowers its head to graze by a river in this printable coloring page, with rounded rocks and a tree along the bank.

pages.title: Mother Capybara Cuddling Her Babies Coloring Page
pages.description: A mother capybara curls around two pups in this printable coloring page, with the babies resting side by side and small grass tufts framing the family.

pages.title: Capybara Family Crossing a Stream Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara and two pups cross a shallow stream in this printable coloring page, leaving ripples between rounded rocks beneath a tree on the bank.

pages.title: Capybara Swimming Past Water Lilies Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara swims through rippling water on this printable coloring page, passing two flowering lily pads with broad round leaves in the foreground.

pages.title: Capybara in a Bathtub Full of Bubbles Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a capybara hooks one paw over the edge of a clawfoot tub filled with bubbles of different sizes.

pages.title: Capybara with a Bird on Its Head Coloring Page
pages.description: A small bird perches between a seated capybara's ears on this printable coloring page, with two simple flowers and tufts of grass below.

pages.title: Capybara Beside a Turtle on a Log Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a capybara beside a turtle on a fallen log above rippling water, with clumps of grass along the bank.

pages.title: Capybara Watching a Frog on a Lily Pad Coloring Page
pages.description: From a bank edged with cattails, a capybara looks down at a frog sitting on a lily pad in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Capybara with a Butterfly on Its Nose Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, a seated capybara looks at a butterfly perched on its nose, with outlined wings and grass beside its paws.

pages.title: Capybara Wearing a Daisy Flower Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: A crown of daisies frames the face of a capybara on this printable coloring page, with rounded petals, pointed leaves, and a broad chest.

pages.title: Capybara Holding an Umbrella in the Rain Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara grips a curved umbrella handle on this printable coloring page, sitting in a shallow puddle under a striped canopy surrounded by raindrops.

pages.title: Birthday Capybara Blowing Out a Candle Coloring Page
pages.description: Wearing a striped party hat, a capybara blows toward a cake candle on this printable coloring page with scalloped frosting, stars, and confetti.

pages.title: Capybara in Sunglasses at the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, a capybara wears oversized sunglasses while sitting on a striped beach towel beside a seashell, with waves behind it.

pages.title: Capybara Floating on a Pool Ring Coloring Page
pages.description: Both front paws of a floating capybara rest on a segmented pool ring on this printable coloring page, with curved ripples surrounding the ring.

pages.title: Capybara Mandala with Leaf Patterns Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated capybara fills the center of this printable coloring page, framed by a circular mandala of broad leaves and small clusters of berries.

pages.title: Christmas Capybara Tangled in Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a capybara wrapped in loops of Christmas lights, with large teardrop bulbs, a striped ornament, and a holly sprig.

pages.title: Halloween Capybara Carving a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: A capybara in a witch hat carves a pumpkin on this printable coloring page, with the lid set beside the jack-o'-lantern on a low table.
